claims.head: Watch for Tolvanen, Cuylle, Laba against Kucherov, Point, Goncalves
claims.body: At home, NY Rangers’s L2 (Tolvanen, Cuylle, Laba) has spent 46% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ second lines. With no line matching it would be about 29%. Tonight Tampa Bay’s usual second line is Kucherov, Point, Goncalves.
